About.Description: Fluxio moves files between your computer and your phone over your local network. Scan a QR code — no cable, no account, no cloud upload.
About.HowItWorksText: Fluxio starts a small local web service only while a session is open. The QR code contains this computer's local address and a one-time secret. Your phone opens the Fluxio page in its browser, you approve it here, and files are streamed directly between the devices and verified with SHA-256.
About.LimitationsText: Both devices must be on the same local network. The connection uses HTTP inside your network (Wi-Fi encryption protects it over the air); avoid untrusted public networks. On phones, browsers decide where downloads are saved, and very large downloads use the browser's download manager and cannot be verified by the page. Transfers stop if the phone locks or leaves the browser.
About.LicenseText: Fluxio is open source under the MIT license.
